notes.title: Version 2.0: Extended Edition
notes.notes:
Thanks to a year of post-launch development and improvements, I'm happy to announce the [b]Extended Edition.[/b]

The new edition adds:
[list]
[*] A bigger, more open world
[*] Way more secrets and puzzles
[*] Major graphics and sound improvements
[*] Story refinements with punchier, funnier dialog and writing
[*] Tighter combat and movement
[*] More enemies, puzzles to battle and areas to travel through
[*] Refined UI, world map and quality of life improvements
[/list]

[b]It's twice as big and better than ever, check it out![/b]

Note for Speedrunners:
To start a new run in OG mode, Turn the timer on and Start a new game, Select OG mode. For anyone not running OG runs, ignore this, the new version is more fun.
